name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of Rs.6,000/year to small and marginal farmers in three equal installments of Rs.2,000 each.
benefits: Rs.6,000/year direct bank transfer in 3 installments of Rs.2,000 each.
application_process: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Submit Aadhaar, land records, and bank details.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefits: Insurance coverage for crop loss. Premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops. Government pays remaining premium.
application_process: Apply through bank, CSC, or pmfby.gov.in before crop sowing cutoff date. Loanee farmers are auto-enrolled.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health cards to farmers with crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers for individual farms.
benefits: Free soil testing, Soil Health Card with nutrient status, crop-wise fertilizer recommendations, improved yield.
application_process: Contact local Agriculture Department or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK). Soil samples collected by government officials.

name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
description: Scheme to provide solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants to farmers for irrigation.
benefits: 60% subsidy on solar pump installation (30% Central + 30% State). Farmers pay only 10%, remaining 30% as bank loan.
application_process: Apply through State Nodal Agency (DISCOM/Agriculture Dept). Submit documents and pay 10% farmer share.

name: PKVY (Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana)
description: Promotes organic farming through cluster approach. Provides financial assistance for organic certification and marketing.
benefits: Rs.50,000/hectare over 3 years for organic farming. Includes organic inputs, certification, and marketing support.
application_process: Form a cluster of 50 farmers with minimum 50 acres. Apply through State Agriculture Department.

name: NMSA (National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture)
description: Promotes sustainable agriculture through soil health management, water use efficiency, and climate adaptation.
benefits: Subsidy for soil health management, water conservation, crop diversification, and climate-resilient practices.
application_process: Apply through District Agriculture Office. Funds released through State Agriculture Department.

name: Micro Irrigation Fund — Drip & Sprinkler Subsidy
description: Provides subsidy for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to promote water-use efficiency under PMKSY.
benefits: 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers, 45% for others on drip/sprinkler systems. Saves 40-50% water.
application_process: Apply through PMKSY portal or District Agriculture Office. Get quotation from empanelled vendor.

name: KCC (Kisan Credit Card)
description: Provides short-term credit to farmers for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities at subsidized interest.
benefits: Credit up to Rs.3 lakh at 4% interest (after 2% interest subvention + 3% prompt repayment incentive). Flexible repayment.
application_process: Apply at nearest bank branch or through PM-KISAN portal. Submit land records and identity documents.

name: National Seed Programme — Seed Subsidy
description: Provides certified seeds at subsidized rates to farmers for improving crop productivity.
benefits: 50% subsidy on certified seeds. SC/ST farmers get additional 10% subsidy. Improved variety seeds at half price.
application_process: Apply at District Agriculture Office or through registered seed dealers. Subsidy credited directly to bank account.

name: Fertilizer Subsidy Scheme (NBS)
description: Government provides nutrient-based subsidy on fertilizers to make them affordable for all farmers.
benefits: Subsidized urea, DAP, MOP, and complex fertilizers. Urea capped at Rs.242/bag. DAP at Rs.1,350/bag (MRP).
application_process: Purchase fertilizers from authorized dealers using Aadhaar-linked PoS machine. No separate application needed.

name: ATMA — Agricultural Technology Management Agency Training
description: Provides training, demonstrations, and exposure visits to farmers for technology adoption and skill development.
benefits: Free training programs, exposure visits, demonstrations, and technology dissemination. Daily allowance for training.
application_process: Register at Block Agriculture Office or KVK. Training schedules announced by District Agriculture Department.

name: PM-KMY (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana)
description: Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing Rs.3,000/month after age 60.
benefits: Rs.3,000/month pension after age 60. Voluntary contribution of Rs.55-Rs.200/month (age 18-40). Government matches contribution.
application_process: Enroll at nearest CSC with Aadhaar and bank details. Monthly contribution auto-debited from bank account.

name: Tamil Nadu IAMWARM — Irrigation & Water Management
description: Tamil Nadu scheme for integrated water management, tank rehabilitation, and irrigation improvement.
benefits: Free tank rehabilitation, canal lining, water user association support, and irrigation infrastructure.
application_process: Apply through Water User Association or District Agriculture Office in Tamil Nadu.

name: Tamil Nadu State Crop Insurance Scheme
description: State-level crop insurance for Tamil Nadu farmers covering all notified crops with premium subsidy.
benefits: Crop loss compensation. Premium fully subsidized for small/marginal farmers by Tamil Nadu government.
application_process: Apply through Village Administrative Officer (VAO) or Agriculture Extension Officer in Tamil Nadu.

name: Maharashtra Magel Tyala Shet Tale Yojana
description: Maharashtra scheme providing farm ponds to farmers for water conservation and irrigation.
benefits: 100% subsidy for farm pond construction. Water storage for irrigation during dry spells.
application_process: Apply through MahaDBT portal or District Agriculture Office in Maharashtra.

name: PMEGP Agriculture — Agro-Processing Loan
description: Provides loans for setting up agro-processing units with subsidy for rural entrepreneurs and farmers.
benefits: 25-35% subsidy on project cost. Loan up to Rs.25 lakh for manufacturing, Rs.10 lakh for service sector.
application_process: Apply online at KVIC portal. Attend EDP training. Submit project report to bank for loan sanction.
